reason: E1 shows that a HEA can superconduct under pressure but does not link this to lattice compression or enhanced electron–phonon coupling; E2 shows pressure-robust Tc in a HEA telluride but does not demonstrate pressure-induced emergence or enhancement of superconductivity via lattice compression. The key mechanistic premises (lattice compression → enhanced coupling → higher Tc) are not directly supported by the cited evidence.
premises: Pressure compresses the lattice of a high-entropy alloy
Enhanced electron–phonon coupling raises Tc or induces superconductivity
The effect occurs in a moderate pressure window (10–50 GPa) without phase decomposition
